Specification of Persistency
AUTOSAR AP R23-11
8.1.3 Redundancy Handling
The
Persistency
supports redundant storage of
Key-Value Storages
,
File
Storages
, and the
key-value pairs
and
files
contained in these. An error in
the stored data that can be fixed using the redundantly stored data will be implicitly
fixed when the
Key-Value Storage
or
File Storage
is accessed, an error is only
returned by
Persistency
when the redundancy fails. To be able to track whether
storage
errors have been fixed using the available redundancy, the
application
can register the following callback function.
